description: This file defines the CardStreamFragment class, a Java Android Fragment responsible for handling a stream of UI cards, including adding, removing, showing, hiding, dismissing, and restoring card views within the app.

classes.name: CardStreamFragment
classes.description: A Fragment managing a stream of Card views, allowing dynamic addition, removal, visibility control, and state restoration of cards.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the cardstream layout, initializes the layout and sets the dismiss listener.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a card to the hidden cards collection and updates internal data structures.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds and optionally shows a card.

methods.name: removeCard
methods.description: Removes a card by its tag, from either visible or hidden collection.

methods.name: showCard
methods.description: Displays a card by its tag, making it visible and optionally dismissible.

methods.name: showCard
methods.description: Displays a card by its tag and sets it as dismissible if specified.

methods.name: hideCard
methods.description: Hides a visible card and moves it to hidden collection.

methods.name: dismissCard
methods.description: Handles the dismissal of a card, moving it from visible to hidden.

methods.name: isCardVisible
methods.description: Checks if a card is currently visible.

methods.name: isCardDismissible
methods.description: Checks if a card is dismissible.

methods.name: getCard
methods.description: Retrieves a card instance by its tag.

methods.name: setFirstVisibleCard
methods.description: Ensures the viewport focuses on a particular card by its tag.

methods.name: getVisibleCardCount
methods.description: Returns the count of currently visible cards.

methods.name: getVisibleCards
methods.description: Returns a collection of all visible cards.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the card stream state from a saved state object.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Serializes the current card stream state for persistence.
